steps.name: Overview: Thai default, KPIs, 10 rich party cards with loaded photos, no audit/OCR UI
Hex map: 77 unique equal tiles mapped to ECT codes; labels are full names only
Bangkok tooltip: full name, 33 constituencies, weighted turnout, invalid ballots, seats; a short summary that points to the full list
Tooltip opens at the pointer, follows it, and can be entered after resting
Single-constituency and multi-party provinces
Party highlight keeps complete province results and shows explicit zero
Map colourings: the two ballots are choices of their own; the province list under the House is gone
Click pins province detail; constituency drill-down; keyboard navigation
Search by combined province + number and by candidate name
English mode translates UI and uses full English province names; Clear All keeps language
Analysis page: four primary charts with their findings, linked brushing, details on demand
Data refresh: icon in the top bar, last-updated time, a saved CSV edit appears in place, a broken edit keeps the old data
Colour theme: follows the device by default, menu beside the flags, a pick outlasts a reload, back to the device setting
